subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw persist compaction trigger/cause metadata while changing successful-turn overflow to require a trusted context snapshot for subagent parent-wake paths?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses provider usage semantics, compaction policy, persisted transcript shape, and live subagent proof, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Add trigger metadata and conservative overflow guard
options.body: Persist a closed compaction reason across session-manager, embedded transcript, and harness entries, and only force successful-turn overflow compaction from trusted context snapshots or provider-specific proof.

options.title: Require live repro before schema work
options.body: Keep the current partial guards and first run a current-main Crabbox/live subagent-yield reproduction to prove the remaining compaction path before changing persisted entries.

options.title: Close after current source guard
options.body: Treat the new `contextUsage` guard as sufficient and defer trigger attribution to a separate diagnostics issue, accepting that the requested metadata remains absent.

recommendation.title: Add trigger metadata and conservative overflow guard
recommendation.body: Persist a closed compaction reason across session-manager, embedded transcript, and harness entries, and only force successful-turn overflow compaction from trusted context snapshots or provider-specific proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision owner is the adjacent usage-accounting contributor tied to the last-call usage contract that this issue depends on.
